spine.entity: one secondary substation's metered flow in one half-hour

world.geography: England (the West Midlands, an invented licence area)

driver: The decisive quantity is what replacing part of a branching line removes from a loss that grows with the square of the flow through that part, when flow is metered only at the line's source and at each draw-off point and a large injection near the line's end sends flow back through the replaced part toward draw-offs near the source; the source meter nets the injection against those draw-offs and the draw-off meters never see it, so the flow through each part has to be rebuilt period by period as the net of every draw-off and injection beyond it, and the line whose source reading looks quietest carries the largest flows where it is replaced.
driver_concrete: Each project's saving is the I2R loss its new conductor removes on the sections it replaces over 2025/26's half-hours; the Hob Moor solar farm exports up to 5 MW back along Kestle feeder's old 0.1 sq in copper overhead sections to the Kestle Park estate near Copsewell Cross primary, so the feeder-head SCADA shows only the estate's daytime load net of the export and the substation monitors show only their own loads, and rebuilt half-hour by half-hour as the net of every substation's flow and every generator's export beyond each section, Kestle's project removes the most losses.
stump: A competent analyst carries each feeder's metered head current through the sections its project replaces and files Oxenford Lane at 558.2 MWh a year, whose old overhead line is charged with a current it never carries; rebuilt from the loads beyond each section the flows pick Copsewell Town at 48.2; only the net of every load and generator beyond each section, the Hob Moor Solar Park's export included, puts Kestle first at 74.2.

differentiation.task101: task101 cuts a threshold from a published distribution less the decision's own earlier payments, a component taken off a total; here nothing is taken off a total: each section's flow is rebuilt as the net of every metered load and export beyond it on the network's topology, and the loss the project removes is the square of that net, which neither the source meter's total nor any draw-off meter gives.
differentiation.task121: task121's second architecture follows each unit's reference through a second party's report to an identifier on a different entity to find the loss its channel carries; here no unit is re-attributed through an identifier: every flow is metered where it is drawn or injected, the bridge is the line's topology, and the decision turns on the square of the net flow through the replaced sections, which reverses when an injection beyond them exceeds the draw beyond them.

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:concordance by distribution matching, not regression
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units fall below a cut on a new instrument's scale when part of the population was measured only on the old instrument; a sample measured on both links the scales, and predicting each unit's new value by regression shrinks every converted value toward the sample's mean, so the converted spread is too narrow and the tail beyond the cut too thin, while matching the percentiles of two groups each measured on one instrument assumes the groups are alike; only a conversion that matches the two instruments' distributions in the sample measured on both keeps the share beyond the cut.

lineage.niche: an adult education service's withdrawal review: the composition of reasons behind the 2025/26 withdrawals, coded from learners' own free-text exit comments, with the moderation return the service draws each year by reason code (every OT, 400 of each other code)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how a population divides between categories that are only ever observed through a classification that is right at different rates for different categories, so a category whose members describe themselves obliquely is under-counted while the category their words get read as is over-counted; counting the assigned labels ranks the categories by how legible they are rather than by how common they are, and only inverting the per-category hit rates measured on a re-classified sample recovers the division the decision needs.
lineage.driver_concrete: Caring-role withdrawals reach the record as sentences about hours ('nobody to sit with mum on thursday so i cant be there for the start'), so the coding manual's caring-role category is recognised in 68 of 100 cases while work hours clash is recognised in 90 and absorbs the spill. Raw coded counts put work hours clash at 24.5 per cent and caring role at 20.1; carrying the moderation return's split behind each code onto the coded counts puts caring role at 25.4 and work hours clash at 20.2, so the 2027 retention budget targets the other reason.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst counts the coded reasons and commits the 2027 retention budget to work hours clash at 24.5 per cent of withdrawals, because the coded counts measure which reasons the coders recognise rather than which reasons learners had; reweighting the coded counts by what the service's own moderation return measures behind each code puts caring role first at 25.4 per cent against work hours clash at 20.2.

lineage.architecture: v9 (pharmacology medication-adherence-persistence, Descriptive & Distribution: a PCN placing statin continuity sessions on the expected number of patients with no statin issued March to June 2027)
lineage.niche: a primary care network placing its clinical pharmacist's statin continuity sessions for January to June 2027 at one of seven general practices, read from the practices' repeat statin issue records, their repeat authorisations and the patient register
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many members of each group will have stopped by a date when a member keeps going only through a renewal reached after a fixed run of uses and nearly all stopping happens at a renewal; a curve on time since each member began, or any trailing rate, spreads those losses evenly and ranks the groups by their history, while running each member forward to its own next renewal shows that one group's members were all restarted together a year earlier, so their renewals fall inside the window.
lineage.driver_concrete: Statin repeats in the seven practices run on authorisations of a fixed number of issues, and nearly every patient who stops does so when the last issue is used and the repeat waits for a clinician to re-authorise it; Marrick House moved most of its stable repeat patients to 56-day issues in February and March 2026, re-authorising each repeat as six issues, so those repeats run out together in January and February 2027 and Marrick House has the most patients with no statin from March to June 2027 (170), while the persistence curve on time since starting, last year's same window and the trailing year's stops all put Cobbet Street first.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst fits each practice's persistence curve on months since starting the statin, carries each patient now on a statin forward on it and sends the pharmacist to Cobbet Street at about 83, whose six-issue repeats give it the steepest curve, with Marrick House last at 46; the losses sit at the end of each repeat authorisation, and Marrick House's spring 2026 move to 56-day issues re-authorised most of its patients' repeats at once, so they run out together before March 2027 and Marrick House has about 170 against Cobbet Street's 129.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-28 at the portal's second determinism return on the same fork (Gate C/D, competing_defensible_answer, golden_wrong): the per-patient chance's estimator was unpinned and a joint-outcome model fitted and validated on the 2024 and 2025 cohorts filed Cobbet Street then Fennbridge; the estimator was the decisive step, so filing it was rule application and a filed back-test handed the clock over; the call itself held on the portal (rubric 72 with the call held).
